styles.name: Anime
styles.description: Clean character illustration with expressive shaped eyes, tapered linework and carefully grouped cel shadows.

instructions.materials: Use opaque digital cel paint with simplified hair, fabric and skin or creature materials.
instructions.forms: Build a compact expressive character with clear head construction and grouped hair or fur masses.
instructions.linework: Draw clean tapered contours, lighter facial lines and precise overlap accents.
instructions.shading: Apply graphic cel shadows with a few controlled highlights on large material groups.
instructions.palette: Preserve distinct local colors with coordinated warm-light and cool-shadow accents.
instructions.texture: Keep surfaces smooth and group strands or folds into a few repeatable shapes.
instructions.rendering: Render an isolated anime-style mascot with the same eye design and facial construction in every state.

negative_constraints: Avoid elaborate scenic lighting, floating expression symbols or decorative speed lines.
Do not add intricate hair strands that change shape and count between frames.
limitations: Detailed eye designs must be simplified enough that gaze and expression remain clear at the profile size.

compatibility.scaling: Render with sufficient source detail, then downsample once with the recommended filter into the existing profile cells; inspect the final silhouette at actual size.
notes: Record approved eye highlights and hair masses as stable design features, distinct from temporary expression changes.
Keep texture and shading inside the isolated silhouette; preserve the same approved pattern placement across animation states.

styles.name: Retro Anime
styles.description: Analog-cel-inspired character with slightly variable ink, broad painted shadow shapes and restrained interior color texture.

instructions.materials: Suggest opaque hand-painted cel color with subtle unevenness inside large fill regions.
instructions.forms: Use compact sculptural head shapes, broad hair locks and deliberately simplified body proportions.
instructions.linework: Draw slightly irregular but confident ink with blunt tapered ends and strong upper-eye contours.
instructions.shading: Use broad hard-edged cel-shadow shapes with very little digital gradient modeling.
instructions.palette: Favor clearly separated painted color families while retaining all required identity hues.
instructions.texture: Allow a restrained interior paint-grain impression without film scratches or full-frame noise.
instructions.rendering: Render the isolated character as a clean preserved cel drawing, keeping any analog texture body-bound.

negative_constraints: Avoid VHS distortion, scanlines across the canvas or a colored cel background.
Do not add misregistered contour fringes that compromise clean extraction.
use_cases: Character sets with a hand-painted cel finish
limitations: Analog texture must stay subtle so it does not look like damaged source artwork at small scale.

compatibility.scaling: Render with sufficient source detail, then downsample once with the recommended filter into the existing profile cells; inspect the final silhouette at actual size.
notes: Prefer alpha around variable ink edges; the analog treatment applies inside the artwork rather than to the entire raster.
Keep texture and shading inside the isolated silhouette; preserve the same approved pattern placement across animation states.

styles.name: Manga Ink

instructions.materials: Use dense black pen ink, opaque light body areas and a few controlled tone patches.
instructions.forms: Keep expressive facial construction and compact anatomy with large readable hair or fur groups.
instructions.linework: Vary contour weight decisively and use finer tapered strokes for eyes and small features.
instructions.shading: Build volume with large black shadow shapes, sparse hatching and limited interior screentone.
instructions.palette: Use ink-and-light value contrast, retaining explicit color identifiers as deliberate adapted accents.
instructions.texture: Confine regular tone patterns and hatch groups to broad body regions.
instructions.rendering: Render an isolated manga drawing with clean alpha outside the contour and no page or panel border.

negative_constraints: Avoid speech bubbles, sound-effect lettering, panel frames or detached action lines.
Do not let dense tone screens obscure eyes or small approved markings.
limitations: Color-dependent identity requires explicit retained accents or an approved value translation.
